profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a public company headquartered in San Francisco, CA that reported revenue of $41,525,000,000 for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026. The company describes its AI approach through its Slack messaging platform, stating that "AI shouldn't make you think, it should help you do." Slack AI features include channel and thread summarization, meeting note-taking, conversation translation, and workflow automation. The company emphasizes that its conversational interface integrates AI directly into where teams already work, rather than confining it to separate tools or browser tabs.

Salesforce offers multiple AI products across its portfolio. Slack AI provides embedded chat and productivity features that summarize conversations, search files, and automate tasks. Tableau AI (Einstein) integrates natural language query capabilities with business intelligence and CRM data through a Trust Layer governance framework. Salesforce Einstein and Agentforce represent the company's CRM-embedded AI and agent offerings, with Agentforce agents able to run directly in Slack channels and threads. The company states that "customer data is not used to train large language models (LLMs)" and that LLM providers do not have access to customer data, with LLMs hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud.

The company maintains six Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers enabling integration with Salesforce systems, including tools for SOQL query execution, data exploration, and DevOps pipeline management. Salesforce faces 220 pending legal matters in California as of the verification date of September 10, 2026.
